claim: Next sprite transparency is pattern index 0, so an outline 'off' option must leave outline pixels out of the images; only an outline colour change is a palette-only change.

evidence.text: Outline off writes no outline pixels (--toggle 'Outline off'); a black outline variant is palette bytes only (outline_colour_nex).
Black outline on standard colours; toggle 'Outline off'; another outline colour is a palette-only change (outline_colour=).
